title: Name Roster Block
description: Name/role/note table for board listings etc. All text fields pass through inline markup.

title.description: Table heading. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

name.description: Person name. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.

role.description: Role or title. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break inside the cell.

note.description: Additional note (e.g. term info). Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a space — the field is single-line.
